notes.company_identity: entity is required; market/security_id are optional narrowing. Omitting both on a name that resolves to more than one security yields status=ambiguous.
notes.document_kinds: empty list means every indexed document kind; duplicates and unknown kinds are refused as invalid_request.
notes.as_of_date: inclusive publication bound. A version whose publication date is unknown is listed with published_date=null at the end of the order, because an unknown date is missing information rather than a future publication.
notes.pagination: cursor is an opaque base64url token over (published_date, document_id). A page resumes strictly after the cursor entry; if a rescan moved the canonical copy of that version, the listing resumes after the last entry that still sorts at or before the cursor instead of failing.
notes.duplicates: identical bytes are one source version with copies counting the owner's indexed physical copies.
notes.availability: available = at least one reusable original location whose file is present; unreadable = indexed but no reusable location or the file is gone; retired = the owner retired the version.
notes.paths: no absolute path, root id, location id, SQLite table shape or consumer-private field is emitted.
notes.ordering: published_date descending with unknown dates last, then document_id ascending; the concatenation of pages equals the unpaged listing.
